rv.q: If it does not set the pulse racing, it presents in Alvin-Wilson a thoughtful, reflective Macbeth whose good sense is overcome by blunt rage.
This production could rival any on the stage of the RSC.
Still, this is a production overflowing with ideas, and if Babych’s interpretation is hard to pin down, it doesn’t lack vision.

cn.t: This modern, combat-primed production earns praise for its bold vision and strong performances, with critics applauding director Mark Babych's imaginative staging and Oliver Alvin-Wilson's compelling Macbeth.
